summary: Full end-to-end test of the new READ-ONLY Payment History feature (Finance Dashboard). Backend: ran /app/backend/tests/test_payment_history.py — 18/18 pytest tests passed (list, pagination, page-size, >100 records, search by invoice/receipt/company, date/method/funding/status filters, empty result, unauthorized/no-token, recent-payments still works, existing payments unchanged, payment detail, sort highest, status=Reversed). Frontend: logged in as arjuna@mddrc.com.my, navigated to Finance Dashboard, verified 'Payment History' tab (data-testid=payment-history-tab) alongside Payments tab; verified Recent Payments card still renders with new 'View All Payments' button (data-testid=view-all-payments-btn) which correctly switches to Payment History tab. Verified table has all 11 required columns (Date, Receipt #, Client/Company, Invoice #, Programme, Funding, Method, Reference, Amount, Status, Actions). Confirmed working: server-side search (debounced, resets to page 1), status filter (Reversed shows red badges), clear filters, sort (newest/highest), page size (25 -> 50), payment detail dialog (data-testid=ph-detail-body) with receipt/date/amount/method/reference/client/invoice/programme/recorded-by/timestamps, Export CSV button triggers download (payment-history-2026-09-02.csv). No data mutation observed — all endpoints are GET-only and pytest 'existing_payments_unchanged' passed. Recording form on Payments tab still renders (not submitted).

issues: Default Status filter is 'Active' (not 'All') — reversed payments are hidden until user explicitly selects Reversed/All. Consider defaulting to 'All' so users see complete history at first glance. This is a UX suggestion, not a bug.

action_items: (Optional UX) Consider defaulting Payment History status filter to 'All' instead of 'Active' so users immediately see the complete historical set including Reversed entries.
critical_code_review_comments: Feature is genuinely READ-ONLY: routes are GET-only, no writes to payments/invoices/ledger observed; pytest test_existing_payments_unchanged confirms DB state preserved.
Endpoint returns clean pagination envelope { items, page, page_size, total, total_pages, sort, filters } — good API design.
Authorization enforced correctly: non-finance role returns 403, no token returns 401 (both pytest-verified).
MongoDB indexes were pre-created (payment_date_created_desc etc.) — good for query performance on historical scans.
seed_data_creation: None. Test used existing 4 payments in DB (2 Active, 2 Reversed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment History feature (Phase 1) fully verified — backend endpoints (/api/finance/payments/history, /history/export, /{id}/detail) and PaymentHistoryTab component both fully functional and integrated. Only observation: default status filter='Active' hides Reversed payments; may want to change to 'All' if UX feedback comes in. The Finance Dashboard has 13 tabs; use data-testid='payment-history-tab' and 'view-all-payments-btn' for future regressions. Preview URL: https://training-finance-hub-1.preview.emergentagent.com
